name: Uchibori Keisuke
source:
An entrepreneur who founded an internet-services company while still at university and now runs several businesses.
He is also highly active on video platforms and is well known as an influencer in his own right.
With his approachable personality and boundless drive, he has won broad support as a capable, energetic executive.

On the other hand, former employees and associates who have left his orbit are often far more critical. Allegations of heavy-handed management and a tendency toward workplace harassment have followed him for years.
He is close friends with fellow influencer Tokiwa Yuji, and the two frequently collaborate on each other's channels.

[From in-game tips]
